theory.title: Exercise 2.1.6: Library Imports
theory.content:
📚 Extending Your Toolkit

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, Robot Framework comes with powerful built-in libraries. Think of them as tool modules you can plug into your tests."

"Collections handles lists and dictionaries. String manipulates text. DateTime works with dates and times. Import them to unlock their keywords!"

📦 What are Library Imports?

Library - Import external functionality into your test suite

  • ✅ BuiltIn - Auto-imported (Log, Should Be Equal, etc.)
  • ✅ Collections - List/dictionary operations (Append To List, Get From Dictionary)
  • ✅ String - Text manipulation (Convert To Lowercase, Should Match Regexp)
  • ✅ DateTime - Date/time operations (Get Current Date, Convert Date)
  • ✅ OperatingSystem - File/directory operations (Create File, Directory Should Exist)

External Libraries (require installation):

  • 🔹 SeleniumLibrary - Web browser automation
  • 🔹 RequestsLibrary - HTTP API testing
  • 🔹 DatabaseLibrary - SQL database operations

📝 Library Import Example

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Use Collections Keywords
    @{mylist}=    Create List    alpha    beta    gamma
    Append To List    ${mylist}    delta
    Length Should Be    ${mylist}    4

Use String Keywords
    ${result}=    Convert To Lowercase    HELLO WORLD
    Should Be Equal    ${result}    hello world

📋 Library Import Rules

  • 🔹 Syntax: Library LibraryName
  • 🔹 Case-sensitive: 'Collections' not 'collections'
  • 🔹 BuiltIn auto-imported: No need to import BuiltIn
  • 🔹 Import location: *** Settings *** section only
  • 🔹 With arguments: Library SeleniumLibrary timeout=10

🎯 Your Task

Import Collections and String libraries. These are built-in, so no installation needed. Later exercises will use keywords from these libraries!
